name: xctl
description: Control your own X account from Claude Code: post, thread, upload media, read timelines and DMs, manage bookmarks and lists, view analytics. Official API first, with an explicit opt-in unofficial transport for likes, follows, profile edits and pinned posts.

spend_cap.title: Monthly spend cap (USD)
spend_cap.description: Hard cap for recorded X API spend per profile. The server refuses operations that would cross it.

profile.title: Account profile
profile.description: Which local profile (credentials and rate budgets) the server should use.

home.title: Config directory (optional)
home.description: Where xctl stores config, state and caches. Leave empty for the platform default.
